style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, deadpan satire, hard noon sun through clear shallow water
motion_rule: he holds his spot over the sunken stall and never travels; the camera slides sideways along the market wall in EVERY beat and reverses at 1.90, 3.60, 5.55 and 7.50, so crates, ropes, buoys and nets tear past behind him; the eel hauls papers across the lens and pale fish sink through it in EVERY beat; his gold gills pump and he works fins, tail and mouth in EVERY beat; he fills half the frame height; new shot size every beat; one action per beat; no push in, no rack focus
character: a plump golden carp upright on his tail, thick lips, heavy jowls, two huge gilded gill covers pumping like bellows
second_characters: ONE lean eel broker in a silk tie, always within a fin of the lens, hauling blank papers across the frame every beat; A SWARM of pale fish with dull gills sinking behind him with papers
props: ONE fat gold ring in the sand under him; ONE blank paper sheet the sinking fish carry; furry mic bottom right
prop_continuity: the papers are never his; the ring is his
environment: a noon bright shallow lagoon over a sunken market: sun shafts to the sand, packed crates, ropes, glass buoys, hanging nets

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: dry chesty male voice, flat and smug, even 4.7 syllables/sec
audio.pacing: first word at 0.0, no silent lead-in; 0.0-3.60 one breath, short breath at 3.60, 3.60-6.85 one breath; after 6.85 only sfx
